create_data_strategy: create a DataStrategy instance with sample options, random selection, replacement, and decay parameters
new_task_data_strategy: generate a new task spec with dynamically determined sample sizes per class using DataStrategy
get_n_samples_classic: get sample count per class using classic cycling, random choice, or pop-based selection from options
decay_n_samples: compute exponentially decaying sample sizes over task steps using max_samples and decay_rate
get_n_samples_schedule: select sample sizes from a stepped schedule based on the number of previous tasks completed
